name: qa-unit-tests-jvm
description: JVM unit testing per-framework wrappers: 6 skills (junit5-tests, kotest-tests, spock-tests, testng-tests, scalatest, assertj) plus 2 agents (jvm-framework-selector, jvm-test-author): the selector recommends a framework from pom.xml / build.gradle[.kts] / build.sbt, the author writes one unit test per spec. Per-framework lifecycle (configure / run / mock / coverage / CI).
